title: NigahSense vision event v1
description: One structured detection event sent by the vision worker to POST /v1/events. Contains metadata and an optional evidence reference only, never image or video bytes.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Breaking changes publish a new file (v2) instead of editing this one.

event_id.description: Unique ID for this message, generated once by the worker. A retry of the same message must reuse the same event_id.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for one real-world occurrence. Every event with the same key is merged into the same incident. Recommended form: <camera_id>:<zone_id>:<session_id>:<track_id>:<event_type>.

event_type.description: v1 supports restricted-zone entry only. Other types are added in later versions.

zone_id.description: Configured zone identifier on that camera, lowercase.

track_id.description: Temporary tracker ID. Valid only within one camera and one worker session; never a person's identity.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the frame that triggered the event, with a UTC offset (e.g. Z or +05:00).

detection_score.description: Detector confidence for this person box (0-1). A model score, not a measure of system accuracy.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to a snapshot or clip already uploaded to media storage.

uri.description: Storage reference: gs://, s3://, https:// or a relative evidence/ path. data: URIs and raw bytes are rejected.
